description: Four-year North America ERA5-Land daily-mean land-state samples on the reviewed NASA one-degree lattice. The CDS request explicitly resamples the 0.1-degree source to a one-degree output grid; it is point-sample context, never acre-scale data. The operator must accept the CDS terms and provide CDS credentials before execution.
